sources.quote: Joseph W. Kennedy, who like me is an instructor in the Department of Chemistry here in Berkeley at the University of California, is collaborating with us on this research.
These chemical investigations are being carried out at my suggestion by one of my graduate students, Arthur C. Wahl, who is starting his second year of graduate work under my direction.
John W. Gofman and Spofford G. English, two graduate students who are starting at Berkeley this fall, have elected to carry out their graduate work under my direction.
I had a discussion with hilio Segr'e, a collaborator in many of my previous research problems.
Joseph W. Kennedy, who like me is an instructor in the Department of Chemistry here in Berkeley at the University of California, is collaborating with us on this research.

With this final separation from Th, it has been demonstrated that our alpha activity can be separated from all known elements and thus it is now clear that our alpha activity is due to the new element with the atomic number 94 (9423'. 94'jb or 94'jb).

Robert Underhill received from Irvin Stewart today a letter dated June 28, 1941 informing him that our contract covering the search for elements 93 and 94 in nature has'been assigned contract number NDCrc-197, Symbol No. 180.

Professor Lawrence received a letter from Dr. Vannevar Bush, Director, Office of Scientific Research and Development, dated August 1, 1941 informing us that the contract I requested in my letter of July 10, 1941 to Dr. Briggs has been approved in the amount of $21,500; it has been assigned the number OEMsr-206, Symbol No. 319.
